checks.name: Place checks run inside the x86_64 emulator
Place queries need no network, location or storage permission
An empty library reports missing imported data
Same-name parks ask for disambiguation with real source options
Recorded locality resolves the correct named park
Named-place response opens the exact OSM source
Recorded aliases and accent normalization resolve the same place
Absent place is scoped to imported data, not invented from model memory
An ambiguous reference cannot silently select a nearby result set
Category/proximity uses the selected reference and explicit radius
Response reports computed distance, recorded address and distance semantics
Unknown positions are disclosed and distant same-category records are excluded
Each nearby result and its reference preserve their own exact citation
A boundary-distance record is included and a record 1 m outside is excluded
Fractional kilometre units are interpreted locally
Miles convert to metres deterministically
Zero radius is rejected explicitly
Oversized search radius is bounded
Travel time is not silently treated as geographic distance
Unimplemented preference/rating filters are not silently dropped
Category search without an area requests context without assuming GPS
Area lookup uses declared locality rather than inventing polygon containment
Missing area coverage produces a scoped empty result
The phone position is never inferred for near-me input
An anchor without coordinates cannot generate distances
Distance lookup works across the antimeridian
Distance arithmetic handles coincident and antipodal coordinates
A locality follow-up resolves the previous named-place question
A radius follow-up retains only the user's previous reference and category
General explanations and personal-file questions remain on the chat/document path
Place scanning honors request cancellation
Identical places in overlapping extracts do not duplicate results
Conflicting source snapshots prevent unqualified ranking or newest-version guesses
Negative local IDs in different extracts are not merged as global identities
Removing source data leaves prior place citations unavailable rather than rebound
Isolated model context has no installed generator
